info.name: Stats API Documentation Analytics Person API

params.name: personId
params.description: Unique Player Identifier. Format: 434538, 429665, etc

params.name: stats
params.description: Type of statistics. Format: Individual, Team, Career, etc. Available types in /api/v1/statTypes

params.name: group
params.description: Comma delimited list of  categories of statistic to return. Available types in /api/v1/statGroups

params.name: season
params.description: Season of play

params.name: seasons
params.description: Comma delimited list of Seasons of play

params.name: sportId
params.description: Top level organization of a sport

params.name: opposingTeamId
params.description: A unique identifier for the opposing team. Must be used with Team ID

params.name: opposingPlayerId
params.description: A unique identifier for the opposing team

params.name: metrics
params.description: Name of metric(s) for metric log stats.  Available metrics in /api/v1/metrics

params.name: leagueId
params.description: Unique League Identifier

params.name: leagueListId
params.description: Unique League List Identifier

params.name: sitCodes
params.description: Situation code for a given stat split.

params.name: combineSits
params.description: If true, gathers stats where all of the situational criteria are met. If false, returns stats where any of the situational criteria are met. Default: false

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start date for range of data (must be used with end date). Format: MM/DD/YYYY

params.name: endDate
params.description: End date for range of data (must be used with start date). Format: MM/DD/YYYY

params.name: daysBack
params.description: Returns results from the last 'X' days (Starting from yesterday).

params.name: gamesBack
params.description: Returns results from the last 'X' games played.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return

params.name: eventType
params.description: Type of event

params.name: pitchType
params.description: Classification of pitch (fastball, curveball, etc...)

params.name: hitTrajectory
params.description: Trajectory of hit (line drive, fly ball, etc...)

params.name: batSide
params.description: Bat side of hitter

params.name: gameType
params.description: Type of Game. Available types in /api/v1/gameTypes

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma delimited list of specific fields to be returned. Format: topLevelNode, childNode, attribute
